referenceHandling: Original stable and leopard were generated from text descriptions. Replacement horse uses its original Higgsfield generation as the edit target and the approved Tide Training lodge as a painted style reference; see per-asset params. Spectral tiger generation provenance is retained below. Each mount's gallop sheet (<id>-run) is a Kling image-to-video of its own still.

stable.prompt: Production asset for a cozy hand-painted fantasy chibi RPG. Bold clean dark ink contours, readable broad painted highlights, compact sturdy shapes, painterly textures rather than photorealism or smooth 3D. One complete isolated subject only. True transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no ground patch, no cast shadow, no text or watermark. Keep all extremities inside frame with 8% transparent padding. Rustic timber STABLE BUILDING with an attractive red tiled pitched roof, heavy warm oak beams, worn cream plaster and a low stone foundation. Compact game building viewed isometrically from above at front three-quarter angle, front entrance facing lower-left of the image. Wide open stable double doorway with a dark interior and a little golden straw inside; small loft hay hatch and simple decorative horseshoe above entrance, small hanging lantern. No animals and no people. Building only: no broad yard or lawn, no surrounding fence, no detached props, just its own tiny threshold and tight foundation. Friendly chunky fantasy architecture, readable when drawn about 160px wide.

horse.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / game sprite redesign. Image 1 is the horse mount EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is ONLY a painted material/shading style reference from the same RPG, not an object to include. Redesign the horse into an adorably goofy, slightly dim-witted but lovable fantasy chibi horse. The original was too conventionally handsome. Give him a bigger soft cream muzzle, comically relaxed half-lidded eyes with a slightly confused cross-eyed glance, one ear casually tilted outward, a tousled scruffy forelock, and a plainly visible little pink tongue flopping out from the right corner of his mouth. Tongue is visible at small game scale, playful silly blep expression, not a huge roaring mouth or grotesque face. Still a robust healthy rideable CHESTNUT HORSE with dark chocolate mane and tail, four strong legs and full rounded hooves. Retain the original exact right-facing three-quarter side pose, body proportions, image-space torso placement, legs and foot placements, saddle position/scale and silhouette below the neck as closely as possible so its existing animation rig fits: saddle seat around(482,437) in1024square coordinates, feet on ground around y970. Keep saddle empty with unobstructed air above for a separate rider. Plain dark brown leather saddle on burgundy cloth, a tiny restrained antique brass egg crest can tie it to the breeding cottage. Match the richer dimensional hand-painted finish, carved-looking bold contours, warm shading and polished fantasy readability of reference2 while keeping natural horse fur and anatomy. No building/architecture in the output. All four legs/hooves fully intact and organically attached, no cut-off feet, no separated pieces, no extra legs. No rider, no big backpack, no loose reins/stirrups across the flank. Preserve original square composition, complete tail/head/ears/hooves inside canvas. TRUE transparent RGBA background, alpha0 outside clean silhouette, no colored background, no checkerboard, no fog or cast ground shadow, no halo. Single full-body horse sprite only, no text or watermark.

leopard.prompt: Production asset for a cozy hand-painted fantasy chibi RPG. Bold clean dark ink contours, readable broad painted highlights, compact sturdy shapes, painterly textures rather than photorealism or smooth 3D. One complete isolated subject only. True transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no ground patch, no cast shadow, no text or watermark. Keep all extremities inside frame with 8% transparent padding. Riderless saddled animal mount, standing calmly in a SIDE VIEW with a slight front three-quarter angle, body horizontal, FACING RIGHT (head to the right, tail to the left). Chibi proportions with oversized appealing head, compact strong torso and relatively short legs. Show all four paws/hooves in a natural staggered stance, clearly separated enough for simple leg animation. All supporting feet share a flat ground line near 85% image height. Put the back and a clear simple flat saddle seat near 48% image height, approximately center x, immediately behind the shoulders; enough empty space above the seat for a separate humanoid rider. Saddle must be low, with a readable seat, no huge pommel, no rider, no packs that hide the seat. No long loose reins or stirrups covering the animal's flank. A powerful spotted LEOPARD riding mount. Golden warm tan fur with clearly painted dark rosette spots, cream lower muzzle/chest, dark ringed long tail curling gently left while staying fully in frame. Large friendly alert feline head, rounded ears, sturdy rounded paws. Simple dark brown leather riding saddle on a desaturated forest-green blanket with small brass trim. Tail must not cross or obscure the saddle. Natural fur colors, no magic glow and no heavy armor.

spectral-tiger.prompt: One complete isolated production game sprite: an ORIGINAL BLUE SPECTRAL SABER-TOOTH TIGER RIDING MOUNT in a hand-painted chibi fantasy RPG style. Bold clean dark ink contours, dimensional painterly fur, compact sturdy shapes, broad readable painted highlights, NOT photorealistic, not smooth 3D. A proud intimidating adult male saber-tooth tiger with broader square muzzle and jaw, thick angular masculine brow, small fierce narrowed cyan eyes, massive muscular neck and shoulders, dense angular cheek ruff, sturdy strong paws and TWO clearly visible ivory UPPER SABER FANGS projecting DOWN past a firmly CLOSED mouth. Lips together, no roaring, NO open mouth, no tongue, no grin, no cute kitten face. Stern controlled aggressive expression. Luminous semi-transparent cyan-blue body with deep sapphire tiger stripes. Cold silver and navy armor: angular cheek guards, sharp shoulder plates, restrained short spikes and engraved panels; no warm gold/orange accents. Horizontal body FACING RIGHT, near-SIDE VIEW with slight front three-quarter angle. FULL BODY including all FOUR feet, tail, both ears and fangs fully inside frame. Four sturdy legs in separated natural staggered stance, all joints organically joined to torso, paws on a horizontal ground line near bottom; enough separation for simple walk animation. A clear low navy-and-silver riding saddle and readable seat on the back immediately behind shoulders, near horizontal center and mid image height. Open empty space above saddle for a separate humanoid rider, no riders or people in this image, no tall pommel or backpacks, no loose reins/stirrups covering flank. Tail curls gently upward on LEFT without crossing the saddle. Animal fills canvas with about 6% safe transparent padding. TRUE transparent RGBA background, alpha0 away from silhouette, no checkerboard, no floor, no ground patch or cast shadow. Only a thin tight cyan rim light along fur; no broad haze, no sprawling smoke, no magical particles outside silhouette, no text or watermark. Original high-fantasy MMORPG-inspired armored spectral feline design with handsome formidable chibi proportions and readable game sprite details.
spectral-tiger.alphaNote: The body is painted at alpha about252 with a restrained blue edge glow; actual translucency of the body can be controlled by the mount renderer. Distant background is alpha0, close glow may be alpha1-20.
spectral-tiger.revision: Adult closed-mouth saber tiger with broad muzzle, narrowed eyes and angular silver armor.

spectral-tiger-run.prompt: Side-view 2D video game sprite animation. The armored blue spectral saber-tooth tiger breaks into a fast, powerful running GALLOP IN PLACE, as if on an invisible treadmill: a continuous, repeating gallop cycle - front legs reach far forward, hind legs push back, the spine flexes and extends, the body rises and falls gently, the tail streams behind. The tiger stays at the exact same spot in the center of the frame and keeps facing right the whole time; it never travels forward, never turns toward the camera, never leaves the frame. Locked static camera: no zoom, no pan, no camera shake. The flat solid magenta background stays perfectly uniform and unchanged - no floor, no ground, no shadow, no dust, no particles, no glow effects. Keep the exact hand-painted chibi fantasy art style, the same blue striped fur, the same silver-and-navy armor and saddle, closed mouth with the two saber fangs. No rider, no text.
spectral-tiger-run.clip: 1280x720, 24 fps, 121 frames; frames 0-20 hold the still, 24-96 gallop in place, then it settles back. One stride is 11 frames (0.46 s); frames 68-78 were used because frame 79 matches 68 (mean difference 4.1 against 8-12 between neighbours).
spectral-tiger-run.keying: magenta keyness min(R,B)-G mapped to alpha, colours unmixed from #F10CEA, red clamped to green+25 against magenta spill, pale ground dust (R>175 and B>175 below video y 470) and blobs not touching the body dropped. Script: scratchpad key.py.
spectral-tiger-run.seatTracking: the saddle was chain-tracked frame to frame with rotated template matching (0.5 degree steps), the 6 degree loop residual spread evenly, then smoothed to three harmonics; the hip sits in the saddle bowl like the still's seat. Tilt is the saddle's canvas rotation (positive = front down); the rider takes half of it.

unusedAlternative.note: start image only (no end image): the gallop is good but the background turned into a lit floor with streaks, so it could not be keyed cleanly.

horse-run.prompt: Side-view 2D video game sprite animation. The goofy chestnut horse with the brown leather saddle breaks into a fast, powerful running GALLOP IN PLACE, as if on an invisible treadmill: a continuous, repeating four-beat gallop cycle - front legs reach far forward, hind legs drive back, the neck and head bob with each stride, the body rises and falls gently, the shaggy dark mane and tail stream behind. The horse stays at the exact same spot in the center of the frame and keeps facing right the whole time; it never travels forward, never turns toward the camera, never leaves the frame. Locked static camera: no zoom, no pan, no camera shake. The flat solid magenta background stays perfectly uniform and unchanged - no floor, no ground, no shadow, no dust, no particles, no motion lines. Keep the exact hand-painted chibi fantasy art style, the same chestnut coat, dark shaggy mane, brown saddle with the maroon blanket and gold buckles, the bridle, and the same goofy tongue-out face. No rider, no text.
horse-run.clip: 1280x720, 24 fps, 121 frames. The backdrop flickers between magenta and pink (keyed per frame from its own corners). One stride is about 10.4 frames; frames 72-81 were used (frame 82 matches 72: difference 1.3 against 4.1 between neighbours).
horse-run.keying: warm-fur keyer (scratchpad mounts2/key3.py): alpha is the lesser of magenta keyness and how much blue-over-green is left, the eroded solid interior forced opaque, shown alpha = alpha/0.75 so motion-blurred legs stay solid; colours unmixed from each frame's own backdrop, blue capped at green+10, blurred edges take the hue of the nearest solid fur, and below the belly line the magenta bounce light the video painted on the legs is corrected (red capped at green/0.45). Each frame is then histogram-matched per channel to the still (grade.py) so the coat does not pump with the video's lighting.
horse-run.seatTracking: chain-tracked like the tiger (trackg.py), loop residual spread evenly, three harmonics; frame 72 sits 9 degrees front-down against the still (the still's saddle matched into it), so tilts are measured from the standing pose.

leopard-run.prompt: Side-view 2D video game sprite animation. The spotted amber leopard with the brown leather saddle breaks into a fast, powerful running GALLOP IN PLACE, as if on an invisible treadmill: a continuous, repeating big-cat gallop cycle - front legs reach far forward, hind legs push back, the spine flexes and extends, the body rises and falls gently, the ringed tail streams behind. The leopard stays at the exact same spot in the center of the frame and keeps facing right the whole time; it never travels forward, never turns toward the camera, never leaves the frame. Locked static camera: no zoom, no pan, no camera shake. The flat solid magenta background stays perfectly uniform and unchanged - no floor, no ground, no shadow, no dust, no particles, no motion lines. Keep the exact hand-painted chibi fantasy art style, the same golden spotted fur with cream belly, the same brown saddle with the green saddle cloth, the same calm face with a closed mouth. No rider, no text.
leopard-run.clip: 1280x720, 24 fps, 121 frames, clean magenta. One stride is 13 frames; frames 78-90 were used (frame 91 matches 78: difference 1.9 against 4.8 between neighbours).
leopard-run.keying: warm-fur keyer (scratchpad mounts2/key3.py): alpha is the lesser of magenta keyness and how much blue-over-green is left, the eroded solid interior forced opaque, shown alpha = alpha/0.75 so motion-blurred legs stay solid; colours unmixed from each frame's own backdrop, blue capped at green+10, blurred edges take the hue of the nearest solid fur, and below the belly line the magenta bounce light the video painted on the legs is corrected (green raised where the cream fur turned pink). Each frame is then histogram-matched per channel to the still (grade.py) so the coat does not pump with the video's lighting.
leopard-run.seatTracking: chain-tracked like the tiger (trackg.py), loop residual spread evenly, three harmonics; frame 78 sits 25 degrees front-down against the still (the still's saddle matched into it); the cat runs with its head low, so the rider leans forward up to about 16 degrees.

geometryNotes.bounds: Inclusive alpha>=128 bounds [x,y,width,height]. Source images have genuine alpha; RGB under zero alpha is intentionally preserved, so RGB-only viewers may show a false colored background.
geometryNotes.legCandidates: [x0,x1,rootY,ankleY,phaseRadians] in 1024px source coordinates. Nonoverlapping source bands support connected knees and complete hooves/paws, with padding for stride and compensation for body rocking. Rider hips follow the transformed saddle; the far boot is masked behind the full body silhouette.
geometryNotes.preservation: The active Higgsfield PNGs are saved byte-for-byte. The spectral tiger and horse were replaced by new generations; previous versions remain in Git history. No recolor, crop or alpha edits were applied.
